members.name: id
members.doc: Stable identity, unique in the tree. A tile that survives a data change morphs to its new size.

members.name: value
members.doc: Leaf size. A branch's size is the sum of its children.

members.name: color
members.doc: Optional second measure for shading, such as growth. A branch uses the size weighted mean of its children.

types.name: TreemapProps
types.doc: Use a treemap for a hierarchy of parts, such as revenue by region, country, and plan, when sizes matter more than exact comparisons.

members.name: data
members.doc: The root. Its label names the whole in the first breadcrumb.

members.name: label
members.doc: What the whole is, such as "Revenue". Names the chart for assistive technology.

members.name: colorLabel
members.doc: Names the shading measure in the tooltip and scale, such as "Growth". Tiles take the hue of their top level branch and grow deeper with the measure. Leave it out to draw every tile at one depth.

members.name: colorDomain
members.doc: Range of the color measure. Defaults to the range of the leaves.

members.name: focus
members.doc: Controlled id of the node that fills the view.

members.name: height
members.doc: Height of the tiles in pixels.
